title: 3D 프린트 티타늄 모노코크 에어로 로드 프레임? ㅣ라겟 에어로원 ㅣ3D Printed Monocoque Aero Road Frame, Laget Aero One

takeaways.text: Explains that the head tube, bottom-bracket area and tube junctions are 3D-printed and joined into one monocoque-style structure rather than mitred and welded from round tubes.
Built the same day with SRAM Red; the top tube, seat tube and seatstays are much thinner than a carbon frame's, which he expects to help aerodynamics (an expectation, not a test).
Korean retail price 17.9 million won through importer MBS Corporation, with a lifetime frame warranty from LAGET and a two-to-three-month lead time after ordering.
Only SRAM wireless electronic groupsets are supported; the frame size shown was too small for the presenter to ride properly.

disclosure: Bike Cabin is a Korean retailer taking orders for the frame through the official importer; the description links its store and phone line.
summary: A Korean retailer's introduction and build of the LAGET AERO ONE 3D-printed titanium frame; Korean automatic captions, no ride test yet.
